about.title: About Me.
about.introLine1: A designer focused on systematic brand visuals and multi-touchpoint implementation.
about.introLine2: I specialize in building brand systems from 0-1, covering visual identity, product CMF, packaging, and marketing visuals, turning them into reusable and iterable design assets.
about.introLine3: In startup brand projects, I've been involved in the entire process from system building to multi-product launches, focusing on validation, iteration, and long-term consistency of design in real-world scenarios.
about.introLine4: For me, design is not about choosing forms, but about continuously solving problems and establishing order based on judgment and experience.
about.contactIntro: Ready to start your next project?
about.contactIntro2: Whether it's a brand new idea or an ongoing project, I'd love to hear about it first.
about.thankYou: Thank you for reaching out. I'll get back to you within 24 hours.

phase-01.title: VI System: Brand Visual Identity & Foundation Standards
phase-01.desc: Establishing unified standards and collaborative language for multi-touchpoint brand expansion through an executable VI specification and asset library.

intro.content: Establishing unified standards and collaborative language for multi-touchpoint brand expansion through an executable VI specification and asset library.

core-principles.title: CORE PRINCIPLES
core-principles.subtitle: Three Core Principles of the System

brand-identity.title: Brand Core Architecture
brand-identity.content: The derivation process from core values to visual expression

principles.title: Other Design Principles
principles.content: Determine other design decisions through the stability principle

logo.title: Logo design is not about formal complexity, but structural stability
logo.content: Through simple and controllable structural logic, ensure the logo maintains consistent recognition across different sizes and media.

logo-structure.title: Logo Structure Analysis
logo-structure.content: Through clear「structural decomposition」, revealing the「internal logic」and「proportional relationships」of the logo design.

logo-focus-lens.title: Logo Detail Focus
logo-focus-lens.content: Diving into「key details」of the logo, showcasing the「refined considerations」and「craftsmanship」in design.

logo-variations.title: Logo Variations Exploration
logo-variations.content: From「wireframe」to「final form」, documenting the「design exploration」and「decision-making process」.

color.title: The color system is established with long-term use as the premise
color.content: Through a limited and clear color range, ensure unified brand perception across different products and scenarios, avoiding visual fatigue caused by short-term trends.

typography.title: Typography supports information expression, not style reinforcement
typography.content: Clear hierarchical relationships ensure the brand maintains a stable reading experience across different content densities.

validation.title: After the system is established, validate through minimum applications
validation.content: These applications are not the final form, but are used to confirm the system's feasibility in real usage scenarios.

summary.title: The outcome of this phase is not a 'complete' brand
summary.content: But a visual foundation that can support subsequent product design and continue to grow through change.

phase-closing.title: Establishing executable specifications for logo / typography / color / layout / graphic grammar around 「VI Assets & Rules」
phase-closing.content: Supporting scalable delivery across multiple products
phase-closing.summary: Establishing executable specifications for logo / typography / color / layout / graphic grammar around 「VI Assets & Rules」, supporting scalable delivery across multiple products, markets, and touchpoints with 「Unified Standards」.

phase-02.title: CUBE: Product System from Positioning to Mass Production
phase-02.desc: Translating audience positioning and product strategy into a mass-producible product system, connecting the full path from concept to delivery.

intro.content: Translating audience positioning and product strategy into a mass-producible product system, connecting the full path from concept to delivery.
intro.emphasis: This is a product that is truly used.

user-generation.title: Target User Generation Analysis
user-generation.content: Using modular output from 'User Persona Research' to focus on the core audience structure of Product A (Gen Z / Gen Y / Gen X), their spending power and behavioral motivations, and translating persona insights into a unified basis for product positioning, feature prioritization, and communication tone.

boundaries.title: Design doesn't start with creativity, but with boundaries
boundaries.content: Using modular 'Positioning Key-Point Cards' to structurally present Product A's category opportunities, audience scenarios (gifting / women's lifestyle / owned traffic) and value propositions (higher AOV, new customer acquisition), enabling team alignment and external communication.
boundaries.emphasis: Define the problem first, then find the solution.

cmf-main.title: CMF Main Exploration
cmf-main.content: Using a 'Color Matrix + Texture Comparison' CMF concept map to clarify the character and hierarchy of different color SKUs at a glance, helping the team quickly converge on direction and advance sampling and mass-production.

cmf-color.content: Using modular follow-ups of 'Sample Photos + Process/Color Issue Checklist + Adjustment Conclusions' to push CMF from concept to mass-producible finish, tracking progress, controlling quality and accelerating iteration.

cmf.title: CMF is the key intermediary connecting brand long-term planning with product implementation
cmf.content: It must serve brand expression while also conforming to product function and manufacturing reality.
cmf.emphasis: Aesthetics is not the goal, but the result under constraints.

factory-keycaps.content: Using a full-process follow-up of 'Accessory CMF Sample Photography + Plating/Spray Color Calibration + Assembly & Durability Verification' to push accessories from exploratory concepts to mass-producible stable versions, ensuring consistency with the main device series and meeting delivery standards.

factory-backplate.content: Using modular follow-ups of 'Factory Backplate Manufacturing Process Documentation + Key Process Inspection Points + Color & Texture Calibration' to translate design intent onto the production floor with stable reproducibility, ensuring consistency and controllability across every production batch.

manufacturing.title: Design decisions must be continuously validated in real manufacturing conditions
manufacturing.content: From materials, components to factory samples, design is always in the feedback loop.
manufacturing.emphasis: Design is not completed in drawings.

priority.content: Using a modular system of 'Super Symbol (graphic / stripe / layout skeleton) reuse on packaging + flavor color differentiation' to make multi-flavor SKUs instantly recognizable and batch-scalable, while simultaneously reducing packaging iteration and new product launch costs.

packaging.title: Packaging is the user's first interface with the brand
packaging.content: It not only carries information, but also affects users' expectations of product value.
packaging.emphasis: The first touchpoint determines the first judgment.

consistency-transition.content: Using a peripheral modular design of 'Lanyard Pattern System + Accessory Combination Rules + Material & Craft Implementation' to extend Product 1's brand identity into daily wear and social scenarios, forming an accessory system that is mass-producible, cross-sellable, and continuously expandable.

component-assembly.content: Using a modular 'One-Page Product Info Wall (structure / specs / selling points / compatibility / usage) + Iconized Modules' approach to package Product 1's core value and sales scripts in one go, supporting channel training, client communication, and rapid reuse in retail displays.

closing.title: Running through the chain 「from strategy to production line」: defining audience and scenarios
closing.content: Ensuring consistent expression and sustainable expansion across all touchpoints through 「CMF × Packaging × Material Synergy」.
closing.summary: Running through the chain 「from strategy to production line」: defining audience and scenarios, solidifying product language and key specifications, ensuring consistent expression and sustainable expansion across all touchpoints through 「CMF × Packaging × Material Synergy」.

intro.content: Establishing an expandable version iteration framework and experience upgrade components while maintaining series recognition consistency.

concept-comparison.title: Product Comparison: Framework Continuity & Experience Upgrade
concept-comparison.content: Using 'Product 1 vs Product 2' comparison to clearly separate inherited brand framework from new experience expressions, making differences instantly readable.
concept-comparison.emphasis: The art of balancing continuity and change

subtitle.changed: Changed: 'Reasonable upgrades' through CMF and details

slide-grid.title: Slide Presentation
slide-grid.content: Using a modular「multi-country KV kit」key visual system to replace target audiences, scenes, and language information within the same brand framework, enabling rapid adaptation and unified communication across different markets.

paired-document-grid.title: Paired Document Display
paired-document-grid.content: Using a「flavor KV serialization template」to split the same communication framework by flavor into batch-expandable key visual assets, achieving instant recognition, unified style, and supporting high-frequency updates for channels and social media.

fly-in-gallery.title: Product Gallery
fly-in-gallery.content: Using a modular「sticker graphic asset pack」design to turn key selling points, flavor identification, and brand symbols into quickly printable offline materials, supporting terminal decoration, promotional giveaways, and community outreach.

grouped-carousel.title: Product Group Display
grouped-carousel.content: Using a modular exploration of「accessory case CMF divergence + texture material library + pendant matching」to transform protection and portability needs into a mass-producible, co-brandable, campaign-ready accessory system, extending daily product use and brand expression.

cards-marquee.title: Cards Marquee
cards-marquee.content: Using a modular「silk-screen pattern library + position specification」design to reserve a quickly replaceable decorative layer on product surfaces, supporting seasonal editions, brand collaborations, and small-batch trials while maintaining brand tonality.

square-grid.title: Product Grid
square-grid.content: Using a full-chain management of「style convergence + prototype-to-production follow-up + packaging kit」to converge exploratory results into viable style combinations, ensuring every launched SKU has clear positioning and complete supporting materials.

panorama-full.title: Panorama Display
panorama-full.content: Using a「one-page product module」information aggregation design to integrate core product specs, key selling points, and visual presentation in a single-screen quick-view format, suitable for internal training, channel briefings, and sales materials.

panorama-marquee.title: Marquee Mixed Display
panorama-marquee.content: Using a modular「disposable pod packaging + flavor card + UI pattern reuse」design to connect multi-flavor standardized packaging with information components, achieving shelf recognition, flavor readability, and supporting combined social media and retail communications.

product-grid-36.title: Product Matrix
product-grid-36.content: Using a systematic「flavor resource library」management to consolidate flavor colors, icons, names, descriptions, and scent classifications into a reusable dataset, supporting efficient production of packaging design, marketing materials, and multi-language adaptation.

document-focus.title: Document Focus
document-focus.content: Using a terminal design of「display rack structure + information layering + flavor display logic」to create a replicable retail standard for product display, ensuring consistent brand presentation, clear information, and smooth customer guidance across different stores and channels.

gallery-upper.title: Systematic documentation of design specifications
gallery-upper.content: Using a hybrid shooting approach of「AI-generated model street photography + real-life scene photography」to transform social media content production into a fast-combinable, on-demand asset pipeline, supporting high-frequency content updates across multiple platforms.
gallery-upper.emphasis: Specifications are the guarantee of consistency

gallery-lower.title: Brand extension and application examples
gallery-lower.content: From products to communication materials, brand visuals maintain consistency across various media.

closing.title: Retaining core identity elements under the goal of 「version expansion and experience upgrade」

phase-06.title: Text Visualization: Transforming Narratives into Reusable Visual Modules
phase-06.desc: Modularizing complex narratives and selling points into a reusable visual component library, improving communication efficiency and material reusability.

intro.content: Modularizing complex narratives and selling points into a reusable visual component library, improving communication efficiency and material reusability.

folder-01.content: Using coordinate positioning modules to compare solution differences — channels and clients instantly see 'why choose us.'

folder-02.content: Using radar charts to quantify experience dimensions like flavor, cleanliness, feel, power, draw, and style — enabling channels to compare multiple models at a glance.

folder-03.content: Using 'device + dual pod solution' combo modules to package different use cases and specs into clear layouts, ready for channel presentation and display.

folder-04.content: Using a modular info wall of feature highlights, structural selling points, ecosystem/community, and color SKUs — packaging the full product picture into a one-page channel brief.

folder-05.content: Using a 'three-mode' parameter layering module to translate feel differences into clear options and benefits — letting clients choose by preference and channels explain by script.

folder-06.content: Using a 'normal/silent' state-switching module to present usage scenarios (visible feedback vs. low disturbance) as instantly selectable selling points for scenario-based recommendations.

folder-07.content: Using 'core selling point cards + 3-step usage flow' modular layout to explain functional candy differences and onboarding in one screen — easy for channel training and instant customer understanding.

folder-08.content: Using a 'real user pain-point evidence wall' to condense frequent complaints about old categories into one-screen consensus, laying clear 'replacement reasons' for channels.

folder-09.content: Using a 'Drops vs Pouches' comparison table module to standardize differences in usage, convenience, flavor, and social experience — instant understanding for clients, instant selling for channels.

folder-10.content: Using 'high-frequency persona scenario cards' to package target users and use cases into deployable, trainable materials — helping channels quickly identify key audiences.

folder-11.content: Using a 'consumption evolution timeline' module to connect global and local category migration paths — helping channels quickly grasp market education context and why new products are inevitable.

folder-12.content: Using a 'trend alignment + product positioning' module to place Oi! within the next-gen evolution narrative — one screen explaining 'why now, why this.'

folder-13.content: Using 'demographic data rings + key mindset profile cards' to present target market age groups and purchase motivations in one screen — helping channels quickly lock in key audiences and talking points.

folder-14.content: Using a 'product evolution ladder' comparison to explain experience upgrades and channel profit logic tier by tier — helping channels understand the shift from basic to touchscreen ecosystem.

folder-15.content: Using 'core features + three theme showcases' modular layout to package touchscreen value (clear display, personalization, real-time info) into ready-to-use selling materials.

folder-16.content: Using 'three-mode difference cards' to turn draw intensity and flavor experience choices into instantly selectable purchase scripts for quick channel recommendations.

folder-17.content: Using 'audience manifesto posters + app community scenes' modular narrative to bind 'next-gen users' with brand social value in one screen — helping channels explain join reasons and retention.

folder-18.content: Using 'app key path demos' modular pages to visually package registration, discovery, following, and friending flows — supporting channel training and quick customer onboarding.

folder-19.content: Using 'near-field connection (NFC) scenario' modular selling points to present offline social triggers and instant interaction as instantly understandable functional value for in-store experience guidance.

folder-20.content: Using 'membership benefits + point tasks + reward drops' modular benefits wall to visually package community retention and repurchase mechanisms into a one-screen benefits narrative — helping channels directly explain 'what you get by joining.'

closing.title: Building a 「narrative module library」 to break down selling points / parameters / scenarios / audiences / trends into standard components with defined combination rules
closing.content: Shifting content production from writing to 「modular assembly」
closing.summary: Building a 「narrative module library」 to break down selling points / parameters / scenarios / audiences / trends into standard components with defined combination rules, shifting content production from writing to 「modular assembly」, improving communication efficiency and reusability.
